description: Recipe ideas from the caller's saved pantry: POST /api/v1/recipes/suggest runs OpenVibe.AI's food.suggest_recipes workflow for the caller (up to three recipes; ingredients from the pantry or cited to Food's food list; what is still to buy priced from Food's own typical prices), 10 a person a day; GET /api/v1/recipes lists the last 20. A person acting for themself needs no capability; an app or agent token needs this one.
